The Collection

Sacred Cranes & Living Tradition

Wings of Return
Acrylic on paper  ·  2023
A crane mid-flight, landing beside its resting companion — a meditation on homecoming and the language of instinct.
Swar Yugal
Gold leaf & acrylic on paper  ·  2023
Two cranes calling skyward in mirror symmetry — their voices joined, their silence shared. Swar Yugal means 'harmony of two voices.'
The Golden Promise
Gold leaf & acrylic on paper  ·  2024
A heart held between two beaks — love as an offering, not a possession. Set against luminous gold, a timeless union.
Ishq aur Aasman
Watercolor & acrylic on paper  ·  2024
Two cranes entwined beneath a dreamt heart. Against a field of teal and terracotta, love is a quiet daydream — and a sunlit flower below bears witness.
Saarang
Acrylic on aged canvas  ·  2022
A single crane bows, another watches skyward. On weathered linen, this study in stillness captures the ancient dance between attention and aspiration.
Karma and Pema
Acrylic on paper  ·  2024
Named for two souls — one poised, one grounded — moving through a garden of wildflowers. A portrait of companionship rooted in the living earth.
New Series

Mandalas from Bhutan

Om Mantra Mandala
A golden Om rests at the heart of concentric rings of sacred script — hand-painted on black ground, radiating stillness and devotion.
Syllables of the Eternal
Spiralling mantras in gold surround a luminous Om — each syllable hand-lettered, evoking the rhythmic chanting of a Bhutanese monastery.
Kalachakra in Crimson
A celestial palace rises within a cosmic circle — the Kalachakra mandala rendered in deep crimson and gold, a map of time and enlightenment.
Kalachakra in Turquoise
Set against a tranquil turquoise ground, this Kalachakra mandala maps the sacred architecture of the cosmos in vivid mineral pigments.
Yantra of the Elements
Interlocking triangles at the centre channel elemental energy, framed by rings of Tibetan script on a deep midnight-blue field.
Lotus Om Mandala
A blossoming lotus cradles the Om at the centre of this mandala — concentric mantras radiate outward in emerald, gold, and teal.
Future Series

Forthcoming Collections

From the scroll painters of Telangana to the sacred geometry of the Himalayan foothills — each series draws from a living tradition, brought into contemporary space with intention.

Series 01  ·  Telangana
🥁
Cheriyal — The Scrolls of Story
Born in the village of Cheriyal near Hyderabad, these vivid narrative scroll paintings depict folklore, mythology, and the lives of ordinary people in bold reds, yellows, and blacks — a living oral tradition made visible.
Coming Soon
Series 02  ·  Telangana
❁
Nirmal — Gold Light on Wood
From the town of Nirmal, these luminous paintings on softwood are finished with a signature golden wash — depicting gods, nature, and court life with a delicacy that makes each piece feel like an illuminated manuscript come to life.
Coming Soon
Series 03  ·  Northeast India & Bhutan

Mandala — The Sacred Circle
Rooted in the Tantric and Tibetan-Buddhist traditions spanning the hills of Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, and the dzongs of Bhutan — these intricate circular compositions are maps of the cosmos, drawn inward toward stillness and devotion.

The Collector

Yogita S.

Founder & Art Collector — The Indian Art Gallery

The Indian Art Gallery is born from a deep fascination with the quiet richness of the Indian Subcontinent — a place where art is not separate from life, but woven into its spiritual and cultural fabric.

In Indian tradition, every motif, every colour, and every pattern carries intention. This gallery translates that philosophy into contemporary spaces.

Each artwork is thoughtfully created or curated to reflect a sense of stillness, balance, and depth — qualities often lost in modern living. These are not just pieces to fill walls, but works that invite pause, reflection, and conversation.

Our collections are designed for those who seek more than aesthetics — collectors, designers, and individuals who value meaning, craftsmanship, and cultural narrative.
